copy.tagline: 把Slack频道消息接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想在自己的应用里收发Slack消息
copy.tagline_en: Add Slack channel messaging to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to send and receive Slack messages from your app

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 就具备了接入 Slack 的执行流程：按步骤复制适配器、装依赖、收集凭证、测试并重启，最终使代理能用 Slack 收发消息。
howto.when: 当你说要接入 Slack 频道（如“加上 Slack 集成”、“把 Slack 接到 NanoClaw”）时触发。

say.text: 用 Socket Mode 把 Slack 接到 NanoClaw 上。
say.note: 选择不需要公网地址的接收方式。

say.text: 用 Webhook 方式接入 Slack，并配置好回调地址。
say.note: 需要提供公网 HTTPS 地址。

say.text: 添加 Slack 集成，完成后重启服务让配置生效。

howto.what_en: When asked to add Slack, Claude runs the full setup: copies the Slack adapter, installs the pinned dependency, prompts for credentials, validates them, resolves the DM channel, and restarts the service so the agent can send and receive Slack messages.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add Slack integration, e.g. 'add Slack integration' or 'connect Slack to NanoClaw'.

say_en.text: Set up Slack in Socket Mode for NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Pick the mode that needs no public URL.

say_en.text: Set up Slack with webhook delivery and configure the callback.
Add Slack integration, then restart the service to apply it.
